message: ## Summary This PR implements comprehensive TypeScript support for the React on Rails install generator, enabling developers to generate TypeScript-based React components with full type safety and modern tooling support. ## Key Features ### 🎯 Generator Options - **New `--typescript` or `-T` flag** for the install generator - Enables TypeScript file generation and dependency installation - Maintains 100% backward compatibility with JavaScript (default behavior) ### 📦 Automatic Dependency Management - **Smart package manager detection** supports npm, yarn, pnpm, and bun - **Essential TypeScript packages** automatically installed: - `typescript` - TypeScript compiler - `@types/react` - React type definitions - `@types/react-dom` - React DOM type definitions - `@babel/preset-typescript` - Babel preset for TypeScript compilation ### 🔧 TypeScript Templates - **Complete `.tsx` template suite** for all React components - **Proper TypeScript interfaces** for component props - **Full type annotations** for state and event handlers - **Server and client components** with type safety - **CSS module support** with type definitions ### ⚙️ Configuration - **Optimized `tsconfig.json`** with React 18+ settings - **Automatic Babel integration** via Shakapacker detection - **Seamless JSX handling** with React automatic runtime ## Technical Implementation The implementation leverages **Shakapacker's automatic TypeScript preset detection**. When `@babel/preset-typescript` is installed, Shakapacker automatically includes it in the Babel configuration, enabling seamless TypeScript compilation without manual configuration. ## Usage Examples ```bash # Generate TypeScript React on Rails application rails generate react_on_rails:install --typescript # Short form rails generate react_on_rails:install -T # With Redux (also supports TypeScript) rails generate react_on_rails:install --typescript --redux ``` ## Generated TypeScript Files ### Component with Props Interface ```tsx interface HelloWorldProps { name: string; } const HelloWorld: React.FC = (props) => { const [name, setName] = useState(props.name); // Component implementation... }; ``` ### Type-Safe Event Handlers ```tsx onChange={(e: React.ChangeEvent) => setName(e.target.value)} ``` ## Breaking Changes **None** - This is a purely additive feature that maintains full backward compatibility. ## Testing ### Generator Tests - ✅ Validates TypeScript file generation - ✅ Ensures proper dependency installation - ✅ Tests compilation success - ✅ Verifies configuration files ### Manual Testing - ✅ Generated components compile successfully - ✅ TypeScript type checking passes - ✅ All package managers work correctly - ✅ CSS modules have proper type definitions ## Addresses This addresses the growing demand for TypeScript support in React on Rails applications and provides a smooth adoption path for teams wanting to migrate to TypeScript. ## Dependencies - Requires **Shakapacker 8+** (already required) - Uses existing **Babel infrastructure** - Compatible with **all supported Node.js versions** 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code) Co-Authored-By: Claude - - - This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/shakacode/react_on_rails/1786) ## Summary by CodeRabbit - New Features - Optional TypeScript generation via --typescript / -T for base and Redux flows, producing TSX client/server entrypoints, Redux wiring, and tsconfig. - Package-manager-aware installation of TypeScript tooling with fallbacks and clear manual instructions. - Generates CSS-module typings. - Tests - Added specs for TypeScript and Redux+TypeScript generation, file outputs, typings, and tsconfig. - Chores - Expanded ESLint ignores to skip template TS files; added @babel/preset-typescript devDependency.
